description: A web platform where cooking enthusiasts can publish recipes, rate and comment on others' dishes, and organize weekly meal plans using their favorite recipes.
target_users: Home cooks looking for new ideas
core_features: User registration, login, and profile management
Create, edit, delete, and browse recipes
Weekly meal plan builder with drag‑and‑drop recipe assignment
Search and filter recipes by ingredients, cuisine, and dietary tags
future_features: Follow other cooks and view their public meal plans
Generate shopping lists from selected meal plans
Push notifications for new recipes and plan reminders

milestones: Initialize repository, CI/CD pipeline, and project scaffolding
Implement authentication and user profile endpoints
Develop recipe CRUD APIs and UI pages
Add basic rating submission and display
Deploy initial version for internal testing
Create meal‑plan APIs and interactive builder UI
Integrate full‑text search and filter options for recipes
Calculate and display average ratings on recipe listings
Conduct user feedback sessions and iterate on UX
Introduce follow system and public meal‑plan browsing
Generate downloadable shopping lists from meal plans
Add push notification service for new content alerts
Scale deployment, monitor performance, and launch publicly
